About Kilimanjaro

Africa's highest peak, in Tanzania

Kilimanjaro is in north-eastern Tanzania, near the town of Moshi. Its highest point, Uhuru Peak, stands at 5,895 m, the highest peak in Africa and the highest free-standing mountain in the world. It has three volcanic cones: Kibo (the summit cone), Mawenzi and Shira. Kilimanjaro National Park is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

  • Cultivated farmland
  • Rainforest
  • Heath and moorland
  • Alpine desert
  • Arctic summit zone

The altitude, cold and long days make good fitness, the right gear and following your guide essential.
